FAQ

Questions about switching to SiteFlow

Yes, for Indian and Gulf teams. Most global construction software charges per user in USD, which adds up quickly when your site workforce is large. SiteFlow is priced per project in INR, meaning you can add unlimited users site engineers, supervisors, subcontractors without costs scaling up. For teams based in India or the Middle East, SiteFlow is typically a fraction of the cost of international alternatives for the same team size.

Most teams are fully live within 3 to 5 days. SiteFlow includes free onboarding a dedicated team walks your site engineers and office staff through the platform specific to your project type. There is no implementation partner needed, no months-long rollout, and no additional setup fees. You can also run SiteFlow in parallel with your current tool during the transition.

Yes. SiteFlow supports projects in the UAE, Qatar, and Saudi Arabia. The platform supports multi-currency billing, works across time zones, and handles Gulf-specific workflows including subcontractor RA billing and materials tracking.

Yes. SiteFlow supports data import for BOQ, material library, party master, rate library, and labour records from Excel. If you are migrating from another platform, the onboarding team will help you map and import your existing data. Historical project data can be carried over so your team does not start from scratch.

Yes, both. SiteFlow integrates directly with Tally and Zoho Books for accounting sync. This means your site expenses, vendor bills, and payroll data flow into your accounting software automatically no double entry. Most alternatives in this space do not support Tally integration, which is the primary accounting software used by Indian construction companies.

SiteFlow does not offer a self-serve trial because construction software works better when set up with your actual project data rather than dummy data. Instead, the process starts with a 10-minute live demo tailored to your project type, followed by a pilot on a real project with full onboarding support included. This gives you a much more accurate picture of whether SiteFlow fits your workflow.

Each comparison is written specifically for Indian and Middle East construction teams. We evaluate software on criteria that actually matter in this market: BOQ support, GPS and face attendance, subcontractor billing, Tally and Zoho integration, INR pricing, and onboarding speed. We do not accept sponsored placements and do not inflate SiteFlow’s scores if a competitor does something better we say so.

The demo is a live 30-minute walkthrough of SiteFlow specific to your project type no generic slides, no sales presentation. An onboarding manager shows you the exact workflows your team would use. If it is a fit, you start a pilot on one real project with full setup support. There is no long-term contract required and no pressure to commit immediately.
